ngay.muc_tieu: AI is all around you, it learns from examples, and a chatbot is really guessing the next word.
ngay.viec: Ask a chatbot to explain a tricky word from your job as if it were talking to a fifth grader.

cau_hoi.cau: When you ask a question, what is an AI chatbot really doing?
lua_chon: Looking up a ready-made answer in a giant dictionary
Guessing the most plausible next word, one word at a time
Understanding and feeling exactly like a person
Passing your question to a staff member
cau_hoi.giai_thich: A chatbot is like a giant predictive keyboard: it picks the best-fitting word, adds it, then guesses the next one. It guesses what sounds most plausible, which is not always the truth.

ngay.ten: Start using AI and write a prompt
ngay.muc_tieu: Open a chatbot, write to it like a real person, and ask with the 4-part formula.
ngay.viec: Write a 4-part prompt for a real task you have today. Not happy with it? Keep messaging so AI fixes it.

cau_hoi.cau: What are the four parts of the prompt formula?
lua_chon: Hello, thank you, sorry, goodbye
Title, intro, body, conclusion
Role, context, task, format
Keywords, hashtags, emoji, links
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Role (who AI plays), context (who you are and who it is for), task (what exactly to do) and format (how to lay it out, how long). Leave a part out and AI has to guess it.

ngay.ten: When AI makes things up, forgets and changes its mind
ngay.muc_tieu: Why AI sometimes makes things up, sometimes forgets, and gives two answers to the same question, and what to do about it.
ngay.viec: Ask AI for a number you need and add: "If you're not sure, say you don't know. Give me sources so I can check."

cau_hoi.cau: AI recommends a book and sounds completely sure. What should you do?
lua_chon: Trust it, since AI sounds so confident
Ask for the source and check it yourself; if the link doesn't open, don't trust it
Ask again and again until it changes its mind
Give up on AI for good
cau_hoi.giai_thich: AI can "hallucinate": when it doesn't know, it still guesses a name that sounds very real. It happens most with numbers, book titles, laws and links. AI is a good assistant, but you are the final checker.

ngay.ten: Asking AI so you get results
ngay.muc_tieu: Three everyday techniques: give examples, give it a role, and ask it to think step by step.
ngay.viec: Take a shopping math problem and ask AI twice: once normally, once adding "think step by step". Compare the answers.

cau_hoi.cau: What is the fastest way to get AI to write captions in your own voice?
lua_chon: Paste 2 or 3 old captions you like as examples (few-shot)
Describe your writing style at great length
Type the whole request in capital letters
Ask the exact same question over and over
cau_hoi.giai_thich: AI is great at copying patterns: a few examples and it picks up your tone, length, even your emoji habits. Tip: use examples on different topics in the same voice, or AI will copy them almost word for word.

ngay.ten: Safety: don't let AI fool you
ngay.muc_tieu: Know what not to paste into AI, spot fake voices and faces, and protect your family.
ngay.viec: Tonight at dinner, pick a family password, and remind everyone never to post it online.

cau_hoi.cau: At midnight, "your child" calls in a panic asking you to transfer money right away. What should you do first?
lua_chon: Send the money at once in case something happened
Read out your OTP code so they can sort it out faster
Hang up and call back on the number you know, or ask for the family password
Send a photo of your ID so they can verify you
cau_hoi.giai_thich: AI can fake a voice from a few seconds of video posted online (deepfake). The usual signs: pressure to hurry, a demand for money or an OTP, and no chance to double-check. Hang up, call back the saved number, and never rush where money is involved.

ngay.muc_tieu: Teach AI who you are, save the prompts you use most, and give each task its own room.
ngay.viec: Open the settings, write three lines about yourself in the custom instructions, then start a new chat and try a familiar question.

cau_hoi.cau: Every new chat, AI forgets who you are. What is the simplest fix?
lua_chon: Paste your password and account number so AI recognizes you
Write a few lines about yourself in the custom instructions
Use one single chat forever
Type your name in big letters at the start of every message
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Custom instructions are like a note stuck on the assistant's desk: AI reads it first every time. Three points are enough: who you are, long or short answers, and how to address you. Never put passwords or account numbers there.

ngay.ten: Put AI to work for real
ngay.muc_tieu: See your job as a bundle of tasks, learn with AI without letting it do the thinking, and plan what to learn next.
ngay.viec: List ten things you do in a week and mark the ones AI could partly help with. That is where you start.

cau_hoi.cau: You really want to understand an exercise you're stuck on. Which prompt fits best?
lua_chon: "Just solve it for me, as fast as possible"
"Write a long answer I can copy"
"Keep it short, no need to explain"
"Don't give me the answer. Ask me step by step so I find it myself"
cau_hoi.giai_thich: When AI solves it for you, it does the hardest part, the thinking, and that is where learning happens. Turn on study mode or tell AI to ask you questions instead. When you just need a quick result, like converting units, ask directly.
